description: This source file implements the DeviceIdentification plugin class for the WPEFramework, handling initialization, deinitialization, device ID retrieval, and related functions. It interacts with system subsystems and manages remote connections.

classes.name: DeviceIdentification
classes.description: A class implementing device identification functionality within the WPEFramework plugin system, managing device IDs, initialization, deinitialization, and handling remote connections.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the device identification plugin, setting up system identifiers and configurations.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters subsystems for the plugin.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: GetDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID, either from subsystem identifiers or system info.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Fills a structure with device identification data such as firmware version, chipset, and device ID.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation events, scheduling plugin cleanup.
